steps: Mapped existing RoundLoop/WaveConfig to ensure the new system is distinct
Created SiegeConfig ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage: archetype stat presets + wave compositions + squad/stagger/gate params

Created SiegeDirector Script in ServerScriptService: waits for a player, runs intermission -> staggered squad spawns from ring gates -> wave-cleared detection (Died OR AncestryChanged) -> next wave -> VICTORY
Disabled the old RoundLoop script to prevent double-spawning (it also held the gate-blocked TestAutoKill hook)

recipe.text: Config-driven siege lifecycle distinct from the prior RoundLoop: waves are COMPOSITIONS of named archetypes (Grunt/Runner/Brute stat presets) rather than flat count/hp tuples. Enemies clone ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate, get archetype stats + NpcDamage attribute, and spawn in staggered squads cycling 4 compass gates on a 32-stud ring. Cleared detection counts each enemy down on Humanoid.Died or model removal; state exposed via SiegeWave/SiegeEnemiesLeft/SiegeState Workspace attributes; prints '[SiegeDirector] Wave N starting/cleared' and a final VICTORY line. No auto-kill/test hooks anywhere.
